celebrities.name: Katrina Kaif
celebrities.caption: Team debunks OTT comeback reports as "misleading and inaccurate"; the actress continues enjoying motherhood after son Vihaan's birth in Nov 2025.

celebrities.name: Diljit Dosanjh
celebrities.caption: Imtiaz Ali and Diljit released a special music video for 'Kya Kamaal Hai' ahead of Main Vaapas Aaunga's June 12 theatrical release, while his AURA Tour 2026 continues.

celebrities.name: Alia Bhatt
celebrities.caption: YRF dropped the Alpha teaser on June 10 — the spy thriller co-starring Sharvari releases July 3, 2026, marking the first female-led YRF Spy Universe film.

celebrities.name: Priyanka Chopra
celebrities.caption: Ranked #3 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 list and named Rolex's newest global brand ambassador; continues filming SS Rajamouli's Varanasi.

celebrities.name: Shah Rukh Khan
celebrities.caption: King's title teaser crossed 90M+ views in 24 hours; the Christmas 2026 release is confirmed with a ₹350-400 crore budget. Ranked #2 most valuable celebrity in India.

celebrities.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
celebrities.caption: Spoke out on the Peddi objectification row, stating "sensuality onscreen does not mean revealing clothes." Also reportedly in talks for Raj & DK's superhero film with Salman Khan.

celebrities.name: Shraddha Kapoor
celebrities.caption: Biopic Eetha locked for August 28, 2026 (Raksha Bandhan) release — she portrays legendary Tamasha artist Vithabai Narayangaonkar in this Maddock Films production.

celebrities.name: Deepika Padukone
celebrities.caption: Expecting second baby with Ranveer Singh (announced April 2026); spotted flaunting baby bump at new Bandra home. Officially joined Allu Arjun's film with director Atlee.

celebrities.name: Ranveer Singh
celebrities.caption: Dhurandhar 2 now streaming on JioHotstar after grossing ₹1800 crore worldwide; next film Pralay begins shooting in August 2026 with a ₹300 crore budget.

celebrities.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
celebrities.caption: The former Miss World maintains a low public profile currently, staying out of the spotlight amid ongoing personal life speculation.

celebrities.name: Rashmika Mandanna
celebrities.caption: Cocktail 2 (with Shahid Kapoor, Kriti Sanon) tops IMDb's most-anticipated list for June 19 release; also reportedly underwent a look test for MS Subbulakshmi biopic.

celebrities.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
celebrities.caption: Reportedly in talks for a Raj & DK superhero film opposite Salman Khan, building on her Family Man and Citadel collaborations with the director duo.

celebrities.name: Allu Arjun
celebrities.caption: Publicly praised cousin Ram Charan's "mind-blowing" performance in Peddi; has a power-packed lineup with directors Atlee, Lokesh Kanagaraj, and Trivikram ahead.

celebrities.name: Ram Charan
celebrities.caption: Peddi crossed ₹185 crore net in India in its first week with ₹261+ crore worldwide; watched the film with fans at Hyderabad IMAX.

celebrities.name: Jr NTR
celebrities.caption: War 2 confirmed for August 14 IMAX release with Hrithik Roshan and Kiara Advani; marks his Bollywood debut in the YRF Spy Universe.

celebrities.name: Janhvi Kapoor
celebrities.caption: At the center of the Peddi objectification controversy; director Buchi Babu Sana apologized and promised scene changes. Also reportedly approached for a Tumbbad director's creature horror film.

celebrities.name: Ananya Panday
celebrities.caption: Spotted with Sushmita Sen, Radhika Apte, and Shoojit Sircar sparking buzz about a secret project; her film Chand Mera Dil crossed ₹30 crore.

celebrities.name: Kiara Advani
celebrities.caption: Wished Toxic director Geetu Mohandas on her birthday, calling her "a genius mind"; the film's BTS video was released, building anticipation for the Yash-starrer.

celebrities.name: Hrithik Roshan
celebrities.caption: Rakesh Roshan dismissed budget clash rumors for Krrish 4, confirming smooth progress with YRF; Hrithik set to make his directorial debut with the superhero sequel.

celebrities.name: Varun Dhawan
celebrities.caption: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai (David Dhawan's final directorial) released June 5; Varun teases his next project will be "very different."

celebrities.name: Shreya Ghoshal
celebrities.caption: Continues her concert tour with upcoming US shows including Vienna on September 6, 2026 at Wolf Trap.

celebrities.name: AR Rahman
celebrities.caption: Made history with his first-ever live performance at the Attari Border on June 7, performing 'Maa Tujhe Salaam' at the Main Vaapas Aaunga music launch event.

celebrities.name: Vijay Thalapathy
celebrities.caption: Jana Nayagan faces fresh distribution rework as Vijay reportedly asks makers to cancel existing deals; the film (his first release since becoming TN Chief Minister) awaits a release date.
